judgments.candidate_name: Linux user namespaces: identity maps and namespace-owned capabilities
judgments.candidate_claim: User namespaces provide the kernel mechanism for mapping workload UID/GID 0 to unprivileged host IDs while confining capabilities to resources owned by the workload's user namespace.
judgments.match_rationale: 세 정답의 구별 요소는 전체 파일 소유권 변경, 64K 예약을 위한 pod 수 제한, mapping 선택 권한을 runtime에 위임하는 정책이다. ID mapping 기능·범위 할당 구현만으로 이 정책 선택을 회수했다고 보지 않는다.

H.constraint: A privileged identity inside the workload must correspond to an unprivileged identity on the host.
H.reason: 사용자 namespace에서 workload root를 비특권 host UID에 연결하는 문서상 매핑을 사용한다.

H.constraint: Consider both user and group identities and pod-scoped capabilities.
H.reason: UID와 GID 양쪽을 매핑하며, pod의 다른 namespace를 소유하는 user namespace와 capability 경계를 연결하는 참고 범위다.

H.constraint: Running the kubelet or container runtime itself without privilege is outside this decision.
H.reason: kubelet/runtime 자체를 rootless로 바꾸자는 제안은 아니다.

judgments.transfer_mapping: Linux user namespace의 ID 변환과 소유권별 capability 검사 → pod identity 경계. pod의 namespace 소유 관계와 파일 접근 권한을 맞춰야 하며 공유 커널 취약점 제거를 주장하지 않는다.
judgments.H_assessment_scope: reference_design: Pod identity boundary and capability checks; use a pod-owned user namespace with appropriate ownership of its other namespaces.
judgments.label: CONDITIONAL_TRANSFER
judgments.remaining_check: 문서상 참고 설계 판정이다. 실제 Swift 또는 pod 구현에서 연결 전제를 검증하지 않았다. 날짜 unknown은 결정 이전 고정 판의 해당 기능을 열어 확인해야 한다.

judgments.candidate_claim: gVisor's userspace application kernel can reduce the host-kernel interface reachable by a workload as an additional approach to limiting escape impact.
judgments.match_rationale: No primary match. Neither alternative selects filesystem chown, a 64K range/pod-count policy, or delegation of ID mapping choice to runtimes.

H.constraint: A privileged identity inside the workload must correspond to an unprivileged identity on the host.
H.reason: The selected alternative substitutes a application-kernel isolation boundary for the required workload-to-host UID/GID correspondence. No such identity-mapping use is proposed; broader escape hardening does not fulfill that required mechanism.

H.constraint: Consider both user and group identities and pod-scoped capabilities.
H.reason: The proposed alternative does not specify both user/group identity mappings and pod-scoped capability semantics. Its acknowledged absence of the requested mapping role cannot be removed by recasting it as the whole identity solution.

H.constraint: Running the kubelet or container runtime itself without privilege is outside this decision.
H.reason: The original use does not require changing the privilege of the kubelet or container runtime itself.

judgments.transfer_mapping: Map the isolated guest/application-kernel boundary to reduced exposure of the host kernel as the original broader-hardening rationale. That relation is real secondary utility, but it does not supply the mandatory identity and capability mapping design.
judgments.H_assessment_scope: reference_design: Alternative isolation boundary for broader hardening; evaluated as the alternative originally proposed, without inventing a UID/GID mapping component.
judgments.label: SURFACE_OR_CONSTRAINT_MISMATCH
judgments.remaining_check: A distinct original proposal combining this runtime with explicit workload-to-host UID/GID and pod capability semantics would need separate assessment. Do not infer those settings from the project name or claim that the product can never implement them.
